amendment_timing: before any two-leg market outcome was produced or inspected
reason: The first exact-head workflow failed at import time because numpy was absent. Subsequent static review identified implementation-validity gaps before any state or PnL result existed.
corrections: Install numpy and pandas in the dedicated research workflow without changing package-wide runtime dependencies.
Require every forward state target to remain inside its 21-day dependence fold.
For spread-cross exits, observe a completed post-entry bar before exiting at the following bar open; never use bar-close information to exit at that same bar open.
Enforce the frozen minimum scored folds and minimum symbol coverage at the state gate.
Evaluate all frozen 6/8/10 bps per-leg cost sensitivities while retaining 8 bps as primary.
Implement the predeclared beta=1 and randomized within-symbol-fold direction controls in addition to reversed-direction and single-leg controls.
Emit PnL-independent feature association diagnostics for the predeclared orthogonality feature set; do not add a second feature in v1.1.
Report parameter-neighborhood support separately and do not allow an isolated highest-PF cell to promote.
Retain development-only, no-OOS, no-edge and no-live claims.
